body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #295

Working tree was already clean (nothing new to commit), and the branch `bb/relay-269-review-debt-04-12-type-the-imap-flag-w-thr_quh8t2vs8r` has been pushed to origin successfully.

## Summary

Typed the IMAP flag write surface (issue #269) to reuse the canonical flag keys instead of accepting a bare `string`:

- `backend/packages/data/src/mail/messageFlags.ts`: added `WritableImapFlag = typeof IMAP_SEEN_FLAG | typeof IMAP_FLAGGED_FLAG`, derived from the existing canonical flag constants, and typed `MESSAGE_FLAG_PROPERTIES`'s `imapFlag` field with it.
- `backend/packages/data/src/mail/imapReconcile.ts`: `ImapMailClient.setMessageFlag`'s `flag` parameter now uses `WritableImapFlag` instead of `string`.
- `backend/packages/data/src/mail/imapFlowClient.ts`: the real `ImapFlowMailClient.setMessageFlag` implementation matches the narrowed type.

Verified: full backend build (`pnpm -r run build`) and test suite (`vitest run`, 24 files / 313 tests) pass; `web` typecheck is clean and unaffected.

## Summary

Addressed all findings from the earlier AI code review on PR #295 for issue #269:

- **`imapReconcile.ts`**: `ImapMailClient.setMessageFlag`'s `flag` parameter is now typed as `WritableImapFlag` (a union of the two canonical constants `IMAP_SEEN_FLAG`/`IMAP_FLAGGED_FLAG` from `messageFlags.ts`), which are now imported directly alongside a new exported `WRITABLE_IMAP_FLAGS` enumerable form.
- **`imapFlowClient.ts`**: the real `ImapFlowMailClient.setMessageFlag` implementation matches the narrowed type.
- **`mailSync.test.ts`**: added a compile-time-only `@ts-expect-error` guard (inside a declared-but-never-invoked function) asserting `setMessageFlag` rejects a non-canonical flag like `\Deleted` — verified this actually catches a regression by temporarily widening the type to `string` and confirming `tsc` then flags the directive as unused.
- **`mailboxClientViewType.ts`**: replaced the `"read"`/`"flagged"` magic-string Zod schema defaults with `READ_PROPERTY_KEY`/`FLAGGED_PROPERTY_KEY` imported from `messageFlags.ts`; runtime defaults unchanged.
- **`mailboxClientView.test.ts`**: added tests confirming the schema still parses to `"read"`/`"flagged"` when those keys are omitted.
- **`messageFlags.ts`**: reordered `WritableImapFlag`'s declaration above `MESSAGE_FLAG_PROPERTIES` for top-to-bottom readability.

Also merged in `develop`'s concurrent changes (unrelated inbox-pipeline/journal work) that had landed on the remote branch, resolved automatically with no conflicts.

Verified after the merge: `pnpm -r run build` (backend, all packages) clean; `vitest run` — **26 test files, 333 tests, all passed**; `web`: `tsc --noEmit` clean.

Also merged in another concurrent `develop` sync (unrelated `module-registry` manifest/registry work) that had landed on the remote branch since my last push — merged cleanly with no conflicts.
